思考模式：不是所有模型都支持，改了点“测试”确认一下: Thinking mode: not every model supports it. Click "Test" after changing it to check
想换成别的服务（OpenAI、通义千问、Kimi……），点“换一个”。以后在 设: Want a different provider (OpenAI, Qwen, Kimi...)? Click "Change". You can also change it later in Settings → Models.
成员少于 {n} 个，再添加一个 Bot 吧。: Fewer than {n} member. Add another bot.
Fewer than {n} members. Add another bot.
或者从模板装一个现成的: Or install a ready-made one from a template
所有 Bot 共享（适合名字、时区这类关于你的基本事实）: Share with all bots (good for basic facts about you, like your name or time zone)
所有 Bot 共用一台电脑（浏览器 + 终端）。几个任务可以同时用，每个任务一个: All bots share one computer (browser + terminal). Several tasks can use it at once, each in its own browser window, sharing logins and files.
手机上可以把它当应用用：Safari 点“分享 → 添加到主屏幕”，Chrome: On a phone you can use it like an app: in Safari tap "Share → Add to Home Screen"; in Chrome tap "Add to Home screen" or "Install app" in the menu.
打开 {console}，创建{app}，在“添加应用能力”里添加{bot}: Open the {console}, create a {app}, and add the {bot} feature under "Add features"
打开 {console}，在“应用开发”里创建一个{app}: Open the {console} and create an {app} under "App Development"
打开 {portal}，点 New Application 建一个应用: Open the {portal} and click New Application to create an app
打开机器人的配置页面，开启 {api}，连接方式选{ws}，拿到 Bot ID: Open the bot's settings page, turn on {api}, set the connection type to {ws}, and copy the Bot ID and Secret
找不到想要的？任何 MCP server 都能接：{add}: Can't find what you need? Any MCP server works: {add}
技能是一个 Markdown 文件（开头写 name 和 description: A skill is a Markdown file with name and description at the top, the same SKILL.md format Claude and others use. You'll review it after importing; it only takes effect once you save it.
技能是交给 {name} 照着做的说明，还没保存。先看一遍做法：别装来路不明的，: A skill is instructions for {name} to follow. It's not saved yet. Read the steps first: don't install skills from unknown sources, and watch for anything that sends your data elsewhere.
把 Bot 的 Chrome 窗口放到屏幕最前面: Bring the bots' Chrome window to the front
把“凭证与基础信息”里的 App ID 和 App Secret 填到下面，点连: Enter the App ID and App Secret from "Credentials & Basic Info" below and click Connect
把“凭证与基础信息”里的 Client ID 和 Client Secret 填: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret from "Credentials & Basic Info" below and click Connect
把名字、头像、职责、技能、定时任务打包，别人装上就得到一个一样的 Bot。对话、: Packs up the name, avatar, instructions, skills and routines. Anyone who installs it gets the same bot. Chats, memory, the Library and app keys are not included.
把它回复里的 token（像 {example}）贴到下面，点连接: Paste the token from its reply (looks like {example}) below and click Connect
把这台的全部数据打成一个加密文件：换机器、从本机搬到服务器时，在新的那台上传它就: Pack all data on this machine into one encrypted file. When you switch machines or move from your own computer to a server, upload it on the new one and pick up where you left off.
拿不准就选 DeepSeek：便宜，中文好。: Not sure? Pick DeepSeek: it's cheap.
拿到链接的人能看到这个技能的做法，可以导入到自己的 open-super-age: Anyone with the link can see this skill's steps and import it into their own open-super-agent. Don't put passwords, tokens or the like in the steps.
按意思找页面，比如“上次做的竞品对比”: Search pages by meaning, e.g. "the competitor comparison from last time"
按意思检索记忆和资料库: Semantic search for memory and Library
换成账号里已有的另一台电脑: Switch to another computer in your account
推荐：硅基流动的 {a}（免费）、OpenAI 的 {b}、本机 Ollama: Suggested: {a} on SiliconFlow (free), {b} on OpenAI, or {c} on local Ollama. Add the matching provider above first.
推送需要 https 访问（本机 localhost 也行）。手机上建议用 Ta: Push needs HTTPS (localhost works too). On a phone, use your Tailscale HTTPS address; see "Remote access" in the docs.
提供模型的平台。填好地址和 API Key 就能用它的模型，密钥加密存在保险库里: Platforms that serve models. Enter the URL and API key to use their models; keys are stored encrypted in the Vault.
搜索，或者直接填模型名字: Search, or type a model name
放弃这段录制？录到的操作不会保存。: Discard this recording? The recorded steps won't be saved.
文件在所有 Bot 共用的电脑里（{root}），Bot 下载、生成的文件都在这: Files live on the computer all bots share ({root}). Anything bots download or create ends up here.
文件太大了，不像是一个 Bot 模板: This file is too big to be a bot template
文件太大了，不像是一个技能: This file is too big to be a skill
断开 {name}？保存的密钥和授权会一起删掉。: Disconnect {name}? Its saved keys and authorization will be deleted too.
新话题 · 之前的对话不再带进上下文，长期记忆还在: New topic · earlier messages are no longer used as context; long-term memory stays
最多同时 {n} 个，多了排队。派出的任务需要时会自动启动，闲置 15 分钟自动: Up to {n} at a time; the rest wait in line. Tasks start it automatically when needed, and it pauses after 15 idle minutes.
有 Bot 等你确认（在私聊里）: A bot needs your approval (in its direct chat)
有 {n} 个密钥解不开（主密钥换过），没有带上。: {n} secret couldn't be decrypted (the master key changed) and was left out.
{n} secrets couldn't be decrypted (the master key changed) and were left out.
有任务在用电脑，用完再换: A task is using the computer. Switch when it's done
服务器上可以定时备份：{cmd}，口令放在环境变量 {env} 里。: On a server you can back up on a schedule with {cmd}, with the passphrase in the {env} environment variable.
服务器在国内的话，要设置 HTTPS_PROXY 才连得上 Discord。: If the server is in mainland China, set HTTPS_PROXY to reach Discord.
服务器在国内的话，要设置 HTTPS_PROXY 才连得上 Telegram。: If the server is in mainland China, set HTTPS_PROXY to reach Telegram.
服务没有自动起来：手动启动它，启动时会换上备份。: The service didn't come back on its own. Start it manually, and it will switch to the backup as it starts.
本机或内网的模型，费用按 0 计: Local or private-network model; cost counted as 0
本机的一般不用填: Usually not needed for local models
松开鼠标，上传到电脑的 uploads 目录: Drop to upload to the computer's uploads folder
模板带好了技能和定时任务，装上就能干活。{name} 也会留着。: Templates come with skills and routines set up, ready to work once installed. {name} stays too.
模板里的人设、技能和定时任务都是给 Bot 的指令。别人分享的模板，装之前点开看: A template's instructions, skills and routines are all directions for the bot. If someone else shared it, open and read them before installing. You can change all of it in the right panel later.
正在上传 {name}…（第一次会先开机）: Uploading {name}… (the computer starts up the first time)
正在听…说完点 ■ 停止，确认文字后再发送: Listening… Click ■ when you're done, then check the text and send
正在录制演示，在右栏“电脑”里操作，做完点“完成”。: Recording. Work in the "Computer" tab on the right, then click "Finish" when you're done.
正在把操作整理成 {name} 的技能…: Turning your steps into a skill for {name}…
正在用环境变量 {env}，在这里填了优先用这里的: Using environment variable {env}. A key entered here takes priority
步骤、要用的网站或应用、输出格式……: What to do, which sites or apps to use, output format…
每个工作日早上 9 点，把 Hacker News 上最热的 5 条整理给我: Every weekday at 9 am, send me the top 5 stories on Hacker News
每天早上 9 点给我整理 AI 领域的重要新闻: Every morning at 9, round up the important AI news for me
比如：每天早上整理 AI 领域的新闻；盯着我关注的几个 GitHub 项目；回邮: For example: round up AI news every morning; keep an eye on a few GitHub projects I follow; show me drafts before replying to emails
没 @ 任何人的消息由协调者接。要确认的操作和“请你帮忙”会出现在对应 Bot: Messages that don't @ anyone go to the coordinator. Approvals and "needs your help" requests show up in each bot's direct chat.
没开着这个页面时（比如手机锁屏），需要你确认、请你帮忙、任务做完和 Bot 的回: When this page isn't open (say, your phone is locked), approvals, requests for your help, finished tasks and bot replies are pushed to devices with push turned on. Nothing is pushed while the page is open.
没有列出模型，可以在上面直接填名字: No models listed. Type a name above
没有找到“{q}”。可以添加自定义应用。: Nothing found for "{q}". You can add a custom app.
没有通知权限，请在浏览器或系统设置里允许这个网站发通知: No permission to notify. Allow this site to send notifications in your browser or system settings
没有麦克风权限，请在浏览器设置里允许: No microphone permission. Allow it in your browser settings
没认出 embedding 模型，可以在上面直接填名字: No embedding models found. Type a name above
没连接的应用可以在侧栏“应用”里连上。: Connect missing apps under "Apps" in the sidebar.
消息里的页面链接、“去网页接手”按钮会用这个地址。手机上要能打开，最好是 htt: Page links and the "Take over on the web" button in messages use this address. It needs to open on your phone; HTTPS is best.
点“打开机器人”，给它发私信，把配对码发过去: Click "Open the bot", DM it and send the pairing code
点下面的服务填上 API Key，或者添加别的服务，再在“各项工作用哪个模型”里: Click a provider below to enter its API key, or add another provider, then switch to it under "Which model for each job".
用这个备份替换这台的全部数据？正在做的任务会被打断。原来的数据库会在服务器上留一: Replace all data on this machine with this backup? Running tasks will be interrupted. A copy of the old database stays on the server.
电脑不跟着走：这台会按自己的设置开电脑，原来电脑里的文件不在备份里。: The computer doesn't come along: this machine starts its own computer from its own settings, and files on the old computer aren't in the backup.
电脑没开（还没创建）。: The computer is off (not set up yet).
画面固定在这个任务的窗口上，再点一下取消: The screen is pinned to this task's window. Click again to unpin
看这个任务每一步做了什么: See what this task did, step by step
看这次运行每一步做了什么: See every step of this run
真正干活的：操作电脑、调用应用、查资料。也要能看图。: Does the actual work: uses the computer, calls apps, looks things up. Also needs to see images.
等你在弹窗里授权…: Waiting for you to authorize in the pop-up…
粘贴 …/template/… 链接，或 GitHub 上的 .osabot.y: Paste a …/template/… link, or a .osabot.yaml on GitHub
给 {name} 布置第一份工作。它会记住你交代的职责，在后台替你完成任务。: Give {name} its first job. It remembers the duties you give it and gets tasks done for you in the background.
置顶到侧栏上方: Pin to the top of the sidebar
至少包含其中一个词（可选）: Contains at least one of these words (optional)
至少要有 {n} 个 Bot 才能建群聊，先去新建一个 Bot。: You need at least {n} bot for a group chat. Create a new bot first.
You need at least {n} bots for a group chat. Create a new bot first.
花了多少钱：按天、按用途、按任务统计。: What you've spent, by day, by use and by task.
装到你自己的 open-super-agent: Install it in your own open-super-agent
装好以后在侧栏“应用”里连上，Bot 才能用它们。: After installing, connect them under "Apps" in the sidebar so the bot can use them.
装好就开始定时运行（不勾的话先暂停，在右栏“定时”里开启）: Start routines right after installing (if unchecked, they stay paused; turn them on under "Routines" in the right panel)
要演示什么？（可选，帮 {name} 理解）: What will you show? (Optional, helps {name} understand)
让 Bot 用上你的应用: Let your bots use your apps
让 Bot 能在这台电脑上执行终端命令？每条命令执行前都会问你，命令能访问这台电: Let bots run terminal commands on this computer? You'll be asked before each command runs. Commands can access every file you can access on this computer.
让模型判断要不要处理（可选）: Let the model decide whether to handle it (optional)
记下了 {n} 条。不对的可以回到列表里改或删。: Saved {n} memory. If it's wrong, edit or delete it in the list.
Saved {n} memories. Edit or delete any that are wrong in the list.
记下了 {n} 条，其中 {k} 条所有 Bot 共享。不对的可以回到列表里改或: Saved {n} memory ({k} shared by all bots). If it's wrong, edit or delete it in the list.
Saved {n} memories ({k} shared by all bots). Edit or delete any that are wrong in the list.
语音识别连不上服务（Chrome 要能访问 Google 的语音服务，Safar: Can't reach the speech recognition service (Chrome needs access to Google's speech service; Safari works as is)
请把你记得的关于我的所有信息列出来，每条一行：我的基本情况、偏好、习惯、正在做的: List everything you remember about me, one item per line: my background, preferences, habits, and what I'm working on. Just the list, no explanations.
请求没报错，但模型没认出测试图片的颜色: The request worked, but the model didn't get the test image's color right
起个名字，在对话里交代它做什么: Give it a name, then tell it what to do in the chat
超时后 Watchdog 自动取消: Watchdog cancels the task when time runs out
超时未确认，按拒绝处理: Not approved in time, so denied
超过以后不再派新的任务，第二天恢复: Once reached, no new tasks start until the next day
输入文字发到电脑（先在画面上点一下输入框）: Type text to send to the computer (tap an input box on screen first)
还差一步：在 Telegram 里打开这个机器人，把配对码发给它。: One more step: open this bot in Telegram and send it the pairing code.
还差一步：在企业微信里找到这个机器人，单聊发配对码给它。: One more step: find this bot in WeCom and send it the pairing code in a direct chat.
还差一步：在钉钉里搜索这个机器人，打开单聊，把配对码发给它。: One more step: search for this bot in DingTalk, open a direct chat and send it the pairing code.
还差一步：在飞书里打开这个机器人，把配对码发给它。: One more step: open this bot in Feishu and send it the pairing code.
还差两步：先把机器人加到你自己的服务器，再私信它配对码。: Two more steps: add the bot to your own server, then DM it the pairing code.
还没有。比如你对它做事方式的要求。: None yet. For example, how you want it to work.
还没有。比如你的名字、时区、所在城市。: None yet. For example, your name, time zone or city.
还没连，以后在侧栏“应用”里连: None yet. Connect them later under "Apps" in the sidebar
还能录 {time} · 只记浏览器里的操作，密码不会记录: {time} left · Only browser actions are recorded, never passwords
这个任务是在更新之前做的，没有记下过程。: This task ran before an update, so its steps weren't recorded.
这个浏览器不支持推送。请换用 Chrome、Edge、Firefox 或 Saf: This browser doesn't support push. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
这个目录是空的。可以上传文件，Bot 在电脑里就能用。: This folder is empty. Upload files here and bots can use them on the computer.
这是 http 地址，不少服务（比如 Slack）只接受 https 的回调地址: This is an http address. Many services (Slack, for example) only accept https redirect URLs. Set up https for this server first (see the deployment docs), then open this page from the https address.
这是之前用 token 接的 {title}。现在可以直接用账号登录，以后不用再: This {title} was connected with a token. You can now sign in with your account instead and stop managing tokens.
连上以后，Bot 能替你查资料、记笔记、整理文件、发邮件。聊天时输入 {at}: Once connected, bots can look things up, take notes, organize files and send email for you. Type {at} in a chat to pick which app to use.
连上以后，Bot 能替你记笔记、查资料、整理文件、发邮件。先连一个常用的试试，以: Once connected, bots can take notes, look things up, organize files and send emails for you. Try connecting one you use often. You can connect more later under "Apps" in the sidebar.
连上后会给你一个配对码，在 Telegram 里发给你的机器人就能用了: Once connected you'll get a pairing code. Send it to your bot in Telegram and you're all set
连上后回到后台的“事件与回调”：事件配置选{ws}，添加事件“接收消息”；回调配: Once connected, go back to "Events & Callbacks" in the console. For events, choose {ws} and add the "Message received" event; for callbacks, also choose persistent connection and add "Card action trigger"
连上后点“把机器人加到你的服务器”，选一个你自己的服务器（没有就先建一个）。Di: Once connected, click "Add the bot to your server" and pick a server of your own (create one if you don't have one). Discord only lets people in a shared server DM a bot
连接中…第一次要下载，可能要一两分钟: Connecting… the first time needs a download, which can take a minute or two
选 {min}–{max} 个 Bot。群里 @ 谁谁回答；不 @ 的消息由协调: Pick {min}–{max} bots. Whoever you @ answers; messages without an @ go to the coordinator, who passes them to the right bot.
选一个服务商。列表里没有的选“其他”，任何兼容 OpenAI 接口的都能用。: Pick a provider. If yours isn't listed, choose "Other": anything with an OpenAI-compatible API works.
配对码过期了（或输错太多次）。: The pairing code expired (or was entered wrong too many times).
重新配对后，原来的私聊就不能再用了。继续？: After re-pairing, the old direct chat can't use it anymore. Continue?
针对这条消息回复，在旁边单独讨论: Reply to this message in a separate thread
针对这条消息的回复只在这里，不进主对话: Replies to this message stay here and don't go into the main chat
钉钉的卡片按钮要另建模板，确认请求改成点链接（或回复“允许 #编号”）。: DingTalk card buttons need a separate template, so approval requests use links instead (or reply "Allow once #N").
链接展示的是这个 Bot 现在的样子，之后改了职责或技能，打开链接看到的也会变。: The link shows this bot as it is now. If you change its instructions or skills later, the link shows the changes too. Don't put passwords or tokens in instructions or skills.
防止任务跑太久、花太多。改完离开输入框就保存。: Keep tasks from running too long or spending too much. Changes save when you leave the field.
这张图片打不开，换一张 PNG 或 JPG 试试: Can't open this image. Try a PNG or JPG
扁平插画风格，正脸，居中，背景是干净的纯色，画面里不要有文字。: Flat illustration style, facing forward, centered, on a clean solid-color background, no text in the image.
给 AI 助手「{name}」画一个可爱的角色头像，头部特写。: A cute character avatar for an AI assistant named "{name}", head close-up.
给群聊「{name}」画一个头像，群里有 {members}，画几个可爱的角色在: An avatar for a group chat called "{name}" with {members}: a few cute characters together.
还没有能画图的模型。在“设置 → 模型”里添加硅基流动、OpenAI、智谱这类有: No image model yet. Add a provider that has image models (SiliconFlow, OpenAI, Zhipu…) in Settings → Models, then come back.
想要什么样的头像: What should the avatar look like?
由你选的模型服务来画，按它的价格收费。: Drawn by the provider you pick and billed at its price.
「{name}」没存到电脑里（{error}）：Bot 能看到图，但不能用它处理: “{name}” was not saved to the computer ({error}): the Bot can see the image but cannot work with the file
打开（电脑没开会先开机）: Open (starts the computer if it is off)
